tracksSubtitle: 11 courses from foundations to deep dives, ordered as a roadmap. "Take first" is a recommendation — every course is open.

1.title: Foundations
1.body: Start here: the AWS building blocks you use daily and how to connect them.

2.title: Deep dives by area
2.body: Go deep on one area at a time: security, networking, compute, data.

3.title: Across areas
3.body: Serverless, reliability and cost — they combine several areas.

4.title: Operations & data
4.body: Ship safely to production and get value from data.

5.title: Capstone
5.body: Design real systems end to end.
